Page 275 Cont.
April 23 Joseph Leahy - 42 - bleeding ulcer of stomach. Vita Delise - 23 - left for army yesterday 29th Mable Seppey - 49 - bleeding ulcers - operation Friday
29 Nancy Wetherbee - 8 - threatening infection in lip and ear ... Mrs. Ida Koffan - 53 - Jewiss of Bay City - inward cancer (womb) An Employee came down last Sunday to Det. and had her name enrolled in Ser. Mass. -
Geo. Clear - about 75 ..
Page 276 Apr. 29 Thanks - Kathleen Sullivan Mrs. Harry Cameron - 46 - Arthritis Peter Ostima - 69 -. ... con. deal
1941, May
May 1 Thanks, Mrs. Elea. Maynes - 82 - broken hip and arm three years ago - in Harper Hospital was given up as hopeless - beleived to have cancer too - was enrolled and blest and prayed for- comes To-day smil- ing that she can walk so well with help of only one crutch.
Mrs. Grace Finazzo - 54 - extremely nerveous - in Receiving Hospital mind threatening .....
Mr. Quigley - Elderly. . . pants. James Griffith - 57 - spinal trouble - slipped on ice 4 yrs ago. Never well since.
Mrs. Standt - 66 - High Bld. pressure Baby Eliz. Fox - 6 mo. - mealsles. . Mrs. Agnes Bramigh - 50 - Sort of Paralysis Coyle Fam. - buy a house - 8 in the Fam.
